claim: A game's own debug or room skip can reach far rooms honestly, but skipping past the last room can crash into ROM and poison later scans, so read the level count first.

evidence.text: Developer room skip: 0x77C2 = 0, hold C with a direction until the room changes, tap SPACE to leave.
Skipping past the last room by the debug routine crashed the game into ROM; a recording past room 16 showed ROM writers and made free memory look used.
